scripts.text:
[Ford]
Hey, it's been a while~
And you even managed to
become a Paladin. You must
have forgotten how to perform
the Shrink skill, so I'll teach
it to you real quick... There!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
嘿，好久不见~
已经成为圣殿十字军了啊。
退缩怎么用，大概忘了吧？
我很快教你一遍...好了！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Damn! Why is it
taking so long?
Ah, finally, you've
arrived! Quick, show me
the ^FF0000report^000000 you've brought!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
可恶，怎么这么久？
啊，总算来了！
快，把带来的^FF0000报告^000000给我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?
Oh, you must have
mistaken me for someone
else. I really don't know
what you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不好意思...？
您大概认错人了，我不知道您在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
What?! You're not one
of the guards stationed
at South Geffen? Oh, this
is horrible. I apologize,
I just assumed since you
were dressed like a Paladin...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
什么？！你不是驻守吉芬南部的卫兵？
糟了，抱歉，看你穿得像个圣殿十字军，我就以为...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
What?! You're not one
of the guards stationed
at South Geffen? Oh, this
is horrible. I apologize,
I just assumed since you
were dressed like a Crusader...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
什么？！你不是驻守吉芬南部的卫兵？
糟了，抱歉，看你穿得像个十字军，我就以为...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry...
What's happening?
Is something the matter?
I'm an adventurer that
goes by the name, {1}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉...发生什么事了？
遇到麻烦了吗？
我是冒险者，叫{1}。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Well, I'm Leslie Ford,
commander of the Prontera
Crusader Guardians. We're
charged with the duty of
protecting adventurers and
citizens from evil monsters.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
我是莱斯利·福特，普隆德拉十字军守卫队的指挥官。
我们负责保护市民和冒险者，抵御邪恶魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
There's been a recent surge
in unprovoked violence from
Goblins and they're making
quite a bit of trouble for us.
Our patrols are supposed to
report on their activity to me.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
最近，哥布灵无端袭人的事件频发，给我们添了不少麻烦。
巡逻队本该将它们的动向报告给我。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
However, today's report
hasn't arrived yet, so I'm
starting to fear that something
has happened to the patrol.
Unfortunately, my duties don't
allow me to leave my post.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
可今天的报告迟迟未到，我担心巡逻队出了事。
偏偏职责在身，无法擅离岗位。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
I'm getting desperate,
and I don't have any choice
but to ask for outside help.
Since you're a fellow Crusader,
I want to ask you if you would
please lend me your aid.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
实在没办法，只好求助外人。
同为十字军，你愿意帮我这个忙吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Great, thank you so much!
Now, please go and seek
out ^0000FFSloutii^000000 who should be
stationed south of Geffen,
and deliver his report to me.
Your help is a great relief...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
太好了，多谢！
请去吉芬南部找驻守那里的^0000FF斯洛蒂^000000，把他的报告送回来。
有你相助，我就放心多了...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Hm. I understand.
I do not know what
obligations that you
have right now, but if
your current task isn't
urgent, please reconsider...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
嗯，我明白。
不知道你身上还有什么差事，若不是急事，还请再考虑一下...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Please search for
^0000FFSloutii^000000 in the area south
of Geffen, and he should
give you his report on
his patrol of the Goblins
for you to deliver to me.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
请去吉芬南部找^0000FF斯洛蒂^000000。
他会把巡查哥布灵动向的报告交给你，请替我带回来。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Wait, you've met with
Sloutii, but haven't
received his report?
Please go back to him
and bring it to me, it's
imperative that I read it!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
等等，你见到斯洛蒂，却没拿到报告？
请再去一趟，务必带回来，我得尽快看到！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Ah, you've returned!
So how is Sloutii?
Is everything all right?
scripts.translation:
[福特]
回来了！
斯洛蒂怎么样，一切还好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, I've brought
this report as soon as
I could! You better read
it, quick! Things seemed
pretty bad when I left...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
报告带来了，我已经尽快赶回来了！
快看看吧，我离开时，情况很不妙...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Goodness, there's blood all
over the paper! Let's see...
Oh no. This is an emergency
situation! I need to report this to Sir Arga and request for
backup immediately!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
天哪，纸上全是血！
我看看...糟了，事态紧急！
必须立刻向阿尔加爵士报告，请求增援！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, we need to do
something about Sloutii.
He was wounded by the
Goblins, and I think he's
in serious trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，还得想办法救斯洛蒂。
他被哥布灵打伤了，我看伤势很重。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
The Goblins...?
Oh no, you'll need the
special antidote that you
can get from Father Arthur
to treat the poison in the
knives these Goblins use.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
哥布灵...？
糟了，它们的刀上有毒，得用亚瑟神父配制的特殊解毒剂！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
While I request for backup,
please go to ^0000FFProntera Church^000000
and ask Father ^0000FFArthur^000000 for his
antidote for Goblin Poison.
If you don't hurry, it might
be too late for Sloutii--!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
我来请求增援，请你赶去^0000FF普隆德拉教堂^000000，向^0000FF亚瑟^000000神父求取哥布灵毒的解毒剂。
再不快点，斯洛蒂就来不及了——！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Please hurry and obtain
the antidote for Goblin's
poison from ^0000FFFather Arthur^000000
in ^0000FFProntera Church^000000. Sloutii's
life depends on you now.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
请赶紧找^0000FF亚瑟神父^000000，他在^0000FF普隆德拉教堂^000000。
向他求取哥布灵毒的解毒剂，斯洛蒂的性命就靠你了。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
You've already met
Father Arthur? Good,
now please hurry and
get the antidote from him.
Without it, Sloutii will slowly
and excruciatingly perish!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
已经见过亚瑟神父了？
好，快请他配解毒剂。
再拖下去，斯洛蒂会在剧痛中慢慢死去！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
You've already met
Father Arthur? Good,
now please hurry and
get the antidote from him.
Without it, Sloutii will slowly
and excruciatingly perish!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
已经见过亚瑟神父了？
好，快请他配解毒剂。
再拖下去，斯洛蒂会在剧痛中慢慢死去！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Great, you've received
the antidote from Father
Arthur! Now, make haste
and administer it to Sloutii
stationed south of Geffen.
Hurry, every second counts!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
太好了，拿到亚瑟神父的解毒剂了！
快去吉芬南部，给斯洛蒂服下。
快，分秒必争！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
I hear that you were
able to save Sloutii.
For that, I am eternally
grateful. We could use more
people like you to serve in the
Prontera Crusader Guardians...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
听说你救活了斯洛蒂，我感激不尽。
普隆德拉十字军守卫队，正需要你这样的人...

scripts.text:
[Ford]
I know that you adventurers
prefer not to commit to these
kinds of organizations, but
your help will always be
welcome here. I hope to
see you again someday.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
我知道，冒险者不爱受这种组织约束。
不过，这里永远欢迎你相助，盼着有机会再见。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Thanks once again,
and I hope to that you
travel in safety. For now,
this is farewell, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
再次感谢，也祝你旅途平安。
那么，就此别过了，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Hey, it's been a while~
You should come by more
often, and if you're really
interested, you can enlist in
my troops. We can really use
somebody with your expertise.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
嘿，好久不见~
有空常来，真感兴趣的话，也可以加入我的部队。
你这样的能手，我们可求之不得。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Great, you've received
the antidote from Father
Arthur! Now, make haste
and administer it to Sloutii
stationed south of Geffen.
Hurry, every second counts!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
太好了，拿到亚瑟神父的解毒剂了！
快去吉芬南部，给斯洛蒂服下。
快，分秒必争！

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Ah, greetings.
I'm sorry that I cannot
assist you, adventurer,
but I have something
rather urgent to take care
of. Now if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[福特]
你好，冒险者。
抱歉，眼下有要紧事要办，没法帮你。
失陪了...

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Hey pal, it's been
a while. I still need
to recuperate from my
wounds, so if you want
to learn Shrink, speak
to Sir Ford, alright?
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
嘿，朋友，好久不见。
我还得养伤，想学退缩，就去找福特爵士吧。

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
So how's that Shrink
skill working out for you?
Hopefully, it's saved your
life as many times as it's
saved mine. Anyway, I'll
see you around, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
退缩用得怎么样？
但愿它也像救我那样，多次救你脱险。
回头见，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Arrrrrghhh!
M-my legs!
What the hell
have they done
to my legs?!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
Arrrrrghhh!
我、我的腿！
他们把我的腿怎么了？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-what happened?
Were you attacked?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎...怎么回事？
你被袭击了？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Y-yeah, I was on my way
to report to Sir Ford on my
regular patrol when I was
attacked by these Goblins!
I've got to warn my superiors!
They're going to raid Geffen!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
对、对，我例行巡逻后正要去向福特爵士汇报，就被哥布灵袭击了！
得赶紧警告上级，它们要袭击吉芬！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I actually spoke to
Sir Ford! You must be
Sloutii, right? He sent me
to see what happened to you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚见过福特爵士！
你是斯洛蒂吧？
他派我来看看你是不是出事了！

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Great, p-perfect timing!
Listen, you've got to send
him this report. I-it contains
details of my patrol and an
urgent request for backup.
U-ugh! We don't have time!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
太好了，来、来得正好！
把这份报告送去，里面有巡逻详情，还有紧急增援请求。
呃啊，没时间了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...!
But what about
you? You're hurt...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...！可你怎么办？
你受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
I'll be damned if help
is delayed on my account!
Just hurry and get that
report to Sir Ford! Now go!
Now, if I can just get that
report out of my-- OW! N-no...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
绝不能因为我耽误救援！
快把报告交给福特爵士，快走！
只要把报告从我这儿拿出——啊！不、不行...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(He's writhing in pain
so much that he can't even
give me his report. I better
bring him a Red Potion to
alleviate his suffering...)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333（他痛得直打滚，连报告都递不出来。
得给他拿瓶红色药水，先缓解一下痛苦...）^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, please take
this Red Potion.
It just might help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给，请喝下这瓶红色药水。
也许会有点帮助...

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Oh, thank goodness!
Arrrgh! Just pour it
into the wound! I-it...
It burns so much! Those
Goblins must've cut me with
something coated in poison!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
谢天谢地！
啊啊，直接倒在伤口上！
烧、烧得好痛！
哥布灵划伤我的东西，肯定涂了毒！

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Ah... Ahh...
The bleeding hasn't
stopped, but at least
it's better. Here, take
this report now and get it
to Sir Ford. Hurry and go!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
啊...啊...血还没止住，不过好多了。
拿去，快把报告送给福特爵士，快走！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received Sloutii's
patrol report. Some of the
pages are smudged with
the blood from his wound.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收下了斯洛蒂的巡逻报告，有几页沾着他伤口流出的血。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Hurry and t-take this
report! L-let me just
hand it to you and th--
Arrrrgh! I-I can't move!
It... It just hurts so much!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
快、快把报告拿去！
等我递、递给你，再——
Arrrrgh! 我、我动不了！
好...好痛！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(I better bring him
a Red Potion, otherwise
I have no hope of getting
that report without hurting him!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333（得给他拿瓶红色药水，不然，想不弄痛他就拿到报告，根本办不到！）

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
We're running out
of time! Hurry and get
my report to Sir Ford as
soon as you possibly can!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
没时间了！
快把报告送到福特爵士手里，越快越好！

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Eeearrrgh--!
My l-legs! Everything
is starting to h-hurt!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
Eeearrrgh--!
我、我的腿！
全身都开、开始疼了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSloutii fell unconscious,
and it seems that the wounds
in his legs are causing him
much more suffering.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF斯洛蒂失去了意识，腿上的伤似乎使他越发痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Eeearrrgh--!
My l-legs! Everything
is starting to h-hurt!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
Eeearrrgh--!
我、我的腿！
全身都开、开始疼了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSloutii fell unconscious,
and it seems that the wounds
in his legs are causing him
much more suffering.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF斯洛蒂失去了意识，腿上的伤似乎使他越发痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSloutii is still
unconscious. He'll
die if his injuries aren't
treated immediately.
You'll have to help him
as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF斯洛蒂仍昏迷不醒，若不立刻救治，恐怕性命难保。
必须尽快帮他。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSloutii is still
unconscious. He'll
die if his injuries aren't
treated immediately.
You'll have to help him
as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF斯洛蒂仍昏迷不醒，若不立刻救治，恐怕性命难保。
必须尽快帮他。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully pour the
Goblin poison antidote
into Sloutii's mouth.
His throat struggles to
swallow the antidote, but
he manages to ingest it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心地把哥布灵毒的解毒剂倒进斯洛蒂嘴里。
他喉头艰难地动了动，总算咽下了药。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFMiraculously, the wounds
inflicted by the Goblins
begin to rapidly heal.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF奇迹般地，哥布灵造成的伤口开始迅速愈合。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Oh, wh-what happened?
Am... Am I really still alive?
Hey, it's you! You must've
saved my life! I thought
I was going to die for sure!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
怎、怎么回事？
我...我还活着？
是你！一定是你救了我！
我还以为这次死定了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's a good thing
I came in time. Sir Ford
had me visit Father Arthur to
make an antidote to save you.
Ah, and I already delivered
your report to Sir Ford.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还好我来得及。
福特爵士让我找亚瑟神父配解毒剂，拿来救你。
对了，报告已经送到福特爵士手里了。

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Great! Now, let me repay you
by teaching you a special skill
developed by the Prontera Crusader Guardians. Using this skill helped
me survive the attack by those
Goblins. You ready to learn?
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
太好了！
为报答你，我教你一项普隆德拉十字军守卫队创出的绝技。
靠着它，我才能从哥布灵的袭击中活下来。
准备好学了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
This skill is called
''^0000FFShrink^000000,'' and it will
knock enemies backwards
when you successfully
guard their attacks.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
这招叫“^0000FF退缩^000000”，成功挡下攻击时，就能把敌人击退。

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Now listen closely...
To execute it, you've got
to be able to concentrate
and repel enemies using
the right stance and mindset...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
仔细听...施展时要全神贯注，摆正架势，调整心境，再将敌人震退...

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Great! You learned the
skill! Now, I hope you use
this ability to combat evil
and protect the weak. Ah, and
if I learn any new skills, I'll be sure to teach you right away.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
好，你学会了！
愿你用它惩恶扶弱。
以后要是学到新招，我一定马上教你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully pour the
Goblin poison antidote
into Sloutii's mouth.
His throat struggles to
swallow the antidote, but
he manages to ingest it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心地把哥布灵毒的解毒剂倒进斯洛蒂嘴里。
他喉头艰难地动了动，总算咽下了药。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, nothing
happened. The antidote
proabably lost its effect
while you were traveling
from Father Arthur to Sloutii.
You've got to return to Father
Arthur and make another one.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF可惜，没有起效。
解毒剂大概在你从亚瑟神父处赶来的路上失效了。
得回去请神父重新配一剂。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Hey, it's you~
So how have you been?
If you ever get some free
time, come by and maybe
we can practice our swordplay.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
嘿，是你呀~
最近怎么样？
有空来找我，一起切磋剑术吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe antidote you
previously administered
had no effect. You've got
to try again by returning to
Father Arthur and making
a new antidote for Sloutii.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF刚才的解毒剂没有起效。
得回去找亚瑟神父，为斯洛蒂重新配一剂，再试一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Please be careful around
this area. Goblins are known
to attack any humans that
they encounter. And lately,
they've been getting even more violent, so stay on the lookout.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
这附近可要小心，哥布灵见人就打。
最近它们愈发凶暴，务必留神。

scripts.text:
[Sloutii]
Please be careful around
this area. Goblins are known
to attack any humans that
they encounter. And lately,
they've been getting even more violent, so stay on the lookout.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛蒂]
这附近可要小心，哥布灵见人就打。
最近它们愈发凶暴，务必留神。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Oh, a Paladin now,
are you? Ah, I'm quite
proud of you. After all, I've
known you back when you
were a brave Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
哦，已经是圣殿十字军了？
真为你骄傲，毕竟，认识你时，你还是位勇敢的十字军。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
I hope that you continue to
use your power to combat
the forces of evil and to
protect the weak. May your
heart guide your actions.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
愿你继续以自己的力量对抗邪恶，保护弱者。
让内心的信念，指引你的行动。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, have you been well?
It is good to see you under
more pleasant circumstances.
Nonetheless, if you think that
I can be of service to you, then please let me know right away.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
近来可好？
这次能在平和些的情形下见面，真是欣慰。
有任何我能帮忙的地方，尽管开口。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Greetings.
How may I be of
service to you today?
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
你好。
今天有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Someone was wounded
by Goblins, and I was told
by Sir Ford that you're the
only one who can make the
Goblin Poison Antidote.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有人被哥布灵打伤了，福特爵士说，只有您能配制哥布灵毒的解毒剂。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Saints preserve us,
the Goblins are indeed
cruel and merciless!
Unfortunately, I'm fresh
out of Goblin Poison Antidote
and must make it from scratch.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
愿圣者保佑，哥布灵果然残忍无情！
可惜解毒剂已用完，得重新配制。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tell me what you
need to make it, and
I'll bring you all of the
materials right away!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我要什么材料，我马上去找！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, yes. Bring me
^0000FF20 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^0000FF3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF5 Jellopies^000000...

[Father Arthur]
...^0000FF1 Coal^000000,
^0000FF1 Grape^000000,
^0000FF3 Cyfar^000000 and
^0000FF1 Unripe Apple^000000.
Now hurry, he won't
last long if he's poisoned!

[Father Arthur]
Ah, you've returned.
Now let me check to
see if you've brought
everything needed to
create the antidote.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
回来了啊。
我看看，配制解毒剂的材料齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Good, good. It looks
like everything is ready.
Now, before I begin, I should
tell you that the antidote has
a time limit of effectiveness.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
好，齐了。
不过，动手之前得提醒你，解毒剂的效力是有时限的。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
However, there's no way
to accurately predict when
the antidote will become
ineffective until you try it.
Therefore, you may have to
return to me for a new batch.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
究竟何时失效，却无法预料，只有用了才知道。
所以，你也许得回来重新拿药。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
These materials should
be enough for multiple
dosages, so you won't have
to worry about collecting
materials again. Now, give
me a moment to distill this...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
这些材料足够配好几剂，不用再去收集。
稍等，我来蒸馏...

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
I'm sorry, but these
aren't enough materials
in order for me to distill the
antidote. Hmm, what were
the required materials again?
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
抱歉，材料还不够配制解毒剂。
嗯，需要些什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, yes. Bring me
^0000FF20 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^0000FF3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF5 Jellopies^000000...

[Father Arthur]
...^0000FF1 Coal^000000,
^0000FF1 Grape^000000,
^0000FF3 Cyfar^000000 and
^0000FF1 Unripe Apple^000000.
Now hurry, he won't
last long if he's poisoned!

[Father Arthur]
Your timing must be
divinely inspired: I've
just completed the Goblin
Poison Antidote. Now please
listen very carefully to me...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
来得真巧，仿佛神意安排，解毒剂刚好配成。
接下来的话，请仔细听...

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
I can't guarantee if this
antidote will work. If it
loses its effectiveness before
you arrive, you'll have to come
back and get a fresh new dose.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
我无法保证这剂药一定有效，若在你赶到前失效，就得回来拿新配的。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
You've got to hurry over
to the wounded as quickly
as possible. Now, as soon as
I hand this to you, you've got
to run there as fast as you
can: a man's life is at stake!
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
得尽快赶到伤者那里。
药一交到手上，就全速跑过去，人命关天！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Here, take the
antidote. Now go!
Godspeed, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
拿好解毒剂，快去吧！
愿神助你一路顺利，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
You haven't left yet?!
Hurry over to the wounded
and administer the antidote!
You'll have to come back for
a fresh batch of antidote if
you arrive there too late!
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
怎么还没走？！
快赶去给伤者服药！
去迟了，药效没了，就得回来重配！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, so the antidote
worked and that man is
expected to fully recover?
Good, good. It does my heart
good to hear he's much better.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
解毒剂起效了，他有望完全康复？
太好了，听说他好转，我也放心多了。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
The antidote failed?!
We have no choice, but
to try it again. Here, let
me quickly distill a new
dosage for you. Wait, wait...
Ah! There! I've finished it!
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
解毒剂失效了？！
只能再试一次。
我马上再蒸馏一剂，稍等，稍等...
啊，好了！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Now take this fresh
antidote and run as
fast as you can to
the wounded! Go!
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
拿好这剂新配的解毒剂，尽快赶到伤者那里！
快去！

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, have you been well?
It is good to see you under
more pleasant circumstances.
Nonetheless, if you think that
I can be of service to you, then please let me know right away.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
近来可好？
这次能在平和些的情形下见面，真是欣慰。
有任何我能帮忙的地方，尽管开口。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, hello there~
Welcome to Prontera
Church. Please relax here,
enjoy the silence, and invite
spiritual calm into your heart.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
啊，你好~
欢迎来到普隆德拉教堂。
请在这里放松一下，享受这份宁静，让心灵获得平静。

scripts.text:
[Father Arthur]
Ah, hello there~
Welcome to Prontera
Church. Please relax here,
enjoy the silence, and invite
spiritual calm into your heart.
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟神父]
啊，你好~
欢迎来到普隆德拉教堂。
请在这里放松一下，享受这份宁静，让心灵获得平静。
